metadata.document_title: MathWorks Multi-Level Taxonomy with Explicit Toolbox Mappings for RAG
metadata.purpose: Enable precise mapping of buyer requirements to specific MathWorks toolbox names. Each use case, workflow, and algorithm includes explicit toolbox mappings for RAG system validation.
metadata.structure: Product Family → Industry → Use Case → Technical Capabilities → **TOOLBOX MAPPINGS**
metadata.key_enhancement: Every workflow, algorithm, and capability now explicitly lists which toolbox(es) provide that functionality
metadata.rag_output_format: Toolbox names are the final validated output for LLM responses

usage_instructions_for_rag.primary_use: This enhanced taxonomy explicitly maps toolbox names to every workflow, algorithm, and capability. Use this structure to validate LLM outputs.
usage_instructions_for_rag.validation_workflow: When RAG system returns recommendations, verify that: (1) The toolbox name is explicitly listed in the relevant use case, (2) The workflow steps reference the correct toolboxes, (3) The algorithms cite the providing toolbox
usage_instructions_for_rag.example_query_flow: User asks 'I need object detection for autonomous vehicles' → RAG retrieves use case → Returns: PRIMARY: Deep Learning Toolbox, SUPPORTING: Computer Vision Toolbox, Automated Driving Toolbox → LLM validates these are the correct toolboxes for YOLO/Faster R-CNN implementation
usage_instructions_for_rag.toolbox_name_format: Always use official toolbox names as listed in quick_reference_toolbox_catalog
usage_instructions_for_rag.multi_toolbox_scenarios: Most real-world applications require 2-5 toolboxes. Primary toolbox provides core functionality, supporting toolboxes enable complete workflow
